supersession_reason: The pre-implementation protocol used the word closing for an exact prestart observation. Version 2 names the evidence truthfully, binds the completed lifecycle, excludes the operational smoke, and adds evidence-era and execution-product separation before any live evidence exists.

scope.github_role: independent verifier, alert, and artifact backup only
scope.reference_market_role: DraftKings prices are reference-market observations, never assumed fills

success_conditions: a future-only MLB schedule plan exists before every target becomes due
each due target has exactly one terminal entry receipt: captured, no_eligible_market, or source_error
raw provider response bytes and quota/timing metadata are retained atomically before resolution
only real DraftKings batter_hits Over and Under outcomes at the same line can form a resolved quote
every resolved quote carries provider event and outcome ids plus exact MLB game_pk/player_id identity artifacts
prediction provenance and every accepted quote complete no later than the declared T-4h target
all raw candidate pairs receive one exhaustive resolution status; model or identity exclusions are counted rather than hidden
an exact prestart reference observation is captured before first pitch, is never labeled a guaranteed closing price or fill, and official outcomes/voids are linked only after MLB Final
every selected and non-selected quote receives a deterministic funnel status and every selected research entry reaches one graded, void, or unscored immutable ledger resolution
the operational smoke is labeled and permanently excluded from every economic denominator
each execution product remains a separate blocked contract until its own account-visible price or payout, submit-ability, acceptance, settlement, actual return, eligibility, and rules evidence exists
the primary collector survives process restarts without rewriting terminal evidence
GitHub detects missing, late, tampered, conflicting, or schedule-drifted targets and goes red without manufacturing replacements
failure_conditions: an API key is stored in source, logs, artifacts, command lines, or workflow files
a post-target entry quote or model snapshot is accepted
a missing side is copied, inferred, de-vigged, or treated as a two-sided market
fuzzy player matching or an ambiguous game/player identity enters final evidence
a raw provider pair disappears without one named funnel status
a retry after the target is represented as an on-time capture
GitHub is represented as a hard-timing primary collector
a partial file, mutable overwrite, or silently intersected model/market universe is published
any shadow artifact promotes a model, opens May 2026, or authorizes wagering
an operational smoke or one execution product enters another product's evidence denominator
a material source, model, configuration, policy, runtime, settlement, schema, or evaluation change continues the same evidence era
protected_invariants: the current Hits model and research policy remain unchanged
the provider supplies prices only; MLB supplies schedule and official outcomes
provider raw evidence remains distinct from independently resolved MLB identity
unavailable projected lineups and missing model rows remain explicit coverage losses
all provider calls are quota-accounted and secrets are read only from the external host secret store
GitHub receives a read-only evidence credential and never receives the odds-provider credential
entry, close, settlement, and authorization are separate contracts
one market or execution product cannot rescue another and heuristic confidence cannot select or size a wager
prospective economic outcomes remain unopened until the separately hashed evidence-boundary artifact is reached

configure the replacement odds key only in the external host secret store
